status: Fictional nonprofit and illustrative planning assumptions, created November 20, 2026
assumptions: Every inquiry is unique across channels after deduplication and assigned to its first recorded source.
All rates are invented planning hypotheses, not observations from Mercy Education Project or industry benchmarks.
Program fit concerns the fictional program's learning goals, schedule and service area; the model contains no individual admission decisions.
Each outreach unit has the same expected response within its small stated cap. Saturation and interaction effects are unknown.
Every booked intake reserves 45 minutes, including appointments that are missed. Every inquiry takes 15 minutes of triage.
The forecast assumes at most one booked intake per inquiry and all starts occur within eight weeks. Reschedules, extra visits and delayed starts require revised inputs.
Staff time comes from an existing allocation and is constrained separately. The cash figure is not a fully loaded economic cost.
The support reserve is held for all 24 seats, including unfilled seats. It is an allocation, not evidence of money spent.
The 18-start planning ceiling preserves room below the 24-seat operational cap. Expected values do not enforce actual bookings or guarantee outcomes.
Instructional staffing for the 24 seats is already funded and outside this outreach and intake model. Retention and GED completion are not estimated.
